Delicious food and lovely people
Aug 2026 • Family
Русская версия:
Ходим в этот вьетнамский ресторанчик в Нячанге уже не первый раз с женой, и каждый раз всё супер вкусно, поэтому решили наконец оставить отзыв.
Отдельно хочется сказать про хостес Нину — она каждый раз встречает нас так тепло и искренне, что сразу понятно, почему хочется возвращаться сюда снова и снова. Никакой наигранности, просто приятный человек, который реально рад гостям.
Ну а еда стабильно на высоте — брали и фо, и спринг-роллы, и морепродукты, всё всегда свежее, вкусное, порции нормальные. Ни разу не было такого, чтобы что-то не понравилось.
Если будете в Нячанге — обязательно зайдите, не пожалеете. Мы сами уже постоянные гости и точно будем возвращаться ещё.
Михаил и Марина
English version:
We've been to this Vietnamese spot in Nha Trang several times now with my wife, and every single time the food has been amazing, so we finally decided to leave a review.
Special mention to the hostess, Peanut — every time we come in she greets us so warmly and genuinely, it's honestly part of why we keep coming back. No fake customer-service vibe, just a really nice person who's actually happy to see you.
The food has been consistently great across all our visits — pho, spring rolls, seafood dishes, always fresh and tasty, good portions too. Never had an off meal here.
If you're in Nha Trang, definitely check this place out. We're basically regulars at this point and will keep coming back.
Mikhail and Marina

A place for a quick lunch
Aug 2025 • Couples
Let's start with the positives: the establishment is conveniently located close to the sea, and the atmosphere itself, like the kitchen, looks clean and neat. One of the nice aspects is the ability to observe the cooking process, which adds confidence to the quality of the food.
We've been here four times and noticed there's no consistent quality of dishes. On two occasions, the food was oversalted, negatively affecting the overall experience. In general, the shrimp in the sauce were delicious, but the process of peeling them left much to be desired-tails are difficult to separate and this makes it difficult to enjoy the dish. It's not clear why the chef chose this way of serving the dish when it could have been done without the tails.
The seafood paste disappointed me. It tasted like a normal saltless pasta with minimal tomato paste and seafood. Although the menu includes shrimp, squid and shells, we were offered to replace the missing shells in the dish with additional shrimp. In the end, there were only four shrimp on the huge plate, which really surprised me. 
Unfortunately, Pina Colada's drink also fell short of expectations. It had nothing to do with the classic recipe, and the immature pineapple used in the preparation made it completely unsweetened. It felt like a green pineapple whipped with ice, no more flavor. 
The ostrich roast was soft, but overly salty and spicy, which nobody warned us about. We also ordered a traditional Vietnamese plate of appetizers, but to our surprise, the waiter did not show how to wrap the rolls correctly, while other visitors were shown this and even prepared the entire roll at the table. As a result, we were unable to enjoy the entire service and left part of the dish on the plate.
The dumpling soup was quite normal, which somewhat smoothed the overall impression. Overall, the establishment's pricing policy is in line with the average, but given the experience, we are not sure we will return here again.

Jul 2025 • Family
Lovely restaurant located near the sea front. It came recommended and didn’t disappoint! 
“Peanut” looked after us beautifully and she has a lovely sense of humour to go with her excellent hostess skills. 
The food was amazing, the fried spring rolls are a must and if you are in to seafood both the fried rice and stir fried noodles with vegetables seafood options are wonderful. The portion sizes are more than enough and we had some left over.
As well as the main menu there is a street food menu for the famous Bahn Mi or a more speedy lunch. 
When we return to Nha Trang we will definitely return to Galagal. 🙂
